title: Patch: true flavour and voice lines for six Core cards and the Felinors
thread:
**Issue #2653 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #2653: Patch: true flavour and voice lines for six Core cards and the Felinors
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

The owner checked how a set of Core cards had been read and found that several flavour lines and voice lines carry the wrong fantasy. Rewrite those cards' `flavour` and `voice` lines in `crates/cards/card-text.yaml` to fit the owner's intent below. Where a card's voice no longer suits it, change that voice in `apps/web/src/audio/card-audio.json5`. Change only the words and the voices. Names, tags, rules text, stats and scripts stay exactly as they are.

**The owner's intent, card by card** (current lines quoted so you can see what is wrong):

| Card | True fantasy | Current flavour / voice (what's wrong) |
|---|---|---|
| `core-007` Jewelosco Scarab | Just a normal scarab: a bug that makes bug noises. No grocery store, no discounts, no clean-up-on-aisle jokes. Its voice lines should be bug noises (clicks, chitters, buzzes), the way the Felinor Token's are cat noises ("Mew!"). | "Found in the dairy aisle, guarding a discount nobody asked for." / "Clean up on aisle you!", "Cleanup time!", "Price check... on death." (voice `goof`) |
| `core-032` Prem Panther | Just a sleek panther. Nothing about subscriptions, premium plans or refunds. | "Premium plan. Premium claws. Premium refund policy: none." / "Premium predator. No ads.", "Premium pounce.", "Subscription cancelled." (voice `hero`) |
| `core-054` Straaza | A big mother dragon. Her Cry, which adds two (3) Cost Units to your hand, can read as her brood or her hoard. | "She's been to every shop and haggled with every clerk." / "Shopping spree! On the house!", "Everything must go!", "Out of stock." (voice `diva`) |
| `core-074` Adaptive UI | A reference to Hearthstone's **Ultimate Infestation**: deal X, heal X, draw X and summon an X/X Ghoul is that card's deal-5 / gain-5 / draw-5 / summon-a-5/5 shape. Nothing about responsive UIs or wallets. | "It resized itself to fit your wallet." / "Now responsive on all devices!" (voice `robot`) |
| `core-092` Felinor Fiender | He loves Felinors and is obsessed with them, in a creepy, romantic, predatory way: an unsettling admirer, played for discomfort and kept PG. He is not a cat collector. **His play line must be exactly "Cats. I need more cats.") | "He counts every cat on the field, and then he becomes them." / attack "Sic 'em, kitties!", death "Who feeds them now?" (voice `crone`, an old woman's voice for a man) |
| `core-096` My Pawn | Your opponent is your pawn: you manipulate them the way Kiyotaka Ayanokōji (*Classroom of the Elite*) does. Calm, expressionless, several moves ahead, steering them from behind the scenes. The line may allude to him; it doesn't have to name him. | "Not today. Not like this. Maybe never, actually." / "Checkmate, puppet." (voice `snob`) |

**Felinors in general.** Felinors are a **cat-person humanoid race**: people, not pets, strays or house cats. Reread every Core Felinor line against that and rewrite the ones that treat them as animals (owners, feeding, "here kitty", "neighbourhood cats"). Cat-like mannerisms such as a purr or "mrow" in speech are fine for a cat-person. The Core cards that touch Felinors:

- `core-012` Duplicating Felinors ("One was cute. Two was a choice. Nobody agreed to three." / "Meow. Meow again.", "Double pounce!", "Both of us?")
- `core-043` Big Felinor ("He loves every cat. He has opinions about everything else." / "Big cat. Bigger problems.", "Big cat pounce!", "Landed on my back?")
- `core-062` Friend of Felinors ("Every cat in the neighbourhood comes when called. They all bring friends." / "Here kitty kitty kitty!")
- `core-086` "Miss" Mrow ("The \"Miss\" is honorary. The claws are not." / "Mrow. Don't touch me.", "Hiss!", "You're all mine now.")
- `core-092` Felinor Fiender (above)
- `core-t-felinor` Felinor Token ("Small, curious, and technically part of an army." / "Mew!", "Mrrp!", "Mew...")

Keep a line that already fits; rewrite only what doesn't. This issue covers only the Core set. The owner will file the other sets separately.

**How** (`docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` rows 7 and 8, and §7):

- Edit the cards' entries in `crates/cards/card-text.yaml`: the `flavour` line (at most 120 characters, no rules words, R660) and each `voice` line (letters, spaces and `, . ' ! ? -` only). Then run `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test export_card_text` and commit the files it rewrites: `crates/cards/flavour.json`, `crates/cards/chinese.json` and `apps/web/src/audio/voice-text.json`.
- Where a voice no longer fits, pick a better one from the voices bank in `card-audio.json5`. Suggestions only: the scarab could use no spoken voice, or one that suits chitters, plus an effect such as `rattle` or `dataBlips`; Straaza something big and maternal such as `elder` or `storyteller` with `fireWhoosh` or `rumble`; Felinor Fiender a man's creepy voice such as `whisper` instead of `crone`; My Pawn a calm, flat voice. Keep a Unit's play, attack and death hooks (R1448).
- Every changed line, and every line given a new voice, must be rendered again. Push a commit whose message holds `[gen:voice]` so the `voice` workflow renders it on GitHub's runners, then push once more so CI runs. If the audio isn't rendered, say in the PR that it is owed.
- No catalog data changes, so no pending fragment claims this: `card-text.yaml` isn't card data (ADDING_CARDS row 8). Run `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` before pushing anyway, and follow what it says.

### Acceptance

- Every line in the table above, and every Core Felinor line that treated Felinors as animals, is rewritten to the owner's intent, and the PR body lists each card's old and new lines.
- `core-092` Felinor Fiender's play line is exactly `More! I need more cats!`.
- No `name`, tag, rules text, stat or script changes. `crates/cards/catalog.json` is untouched.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test export_card_text` passes, and the three generated files are committed.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test` passes, including `voice-lines.test.ts`, `voiceData.test.ts` and `src/cards/flavour.test.tsx`, and so does `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` (`tests/cross/flavour.rs`).
- The changed lines are rendered by the `voice` workflow (`gen-voice.mjs --check` passes), or the PR says the audio is owed.

### Blocked by, part of

Nothing.

## Plan

_Written by `claude-8` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41280548523)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Give six Core cards (`core-007` Jewelosco Scarab, `core-032` Prem Panther, `core-054` Straaza, `core-074` Adaptive UI, `core-092` Felinor Fiender, `core-096` My Pawn) a new `flavour` line and new `voice` lines in `crates/cards/card-text.yaml` that match the owner's intent. Rewrite the Core Felinor lines that treat Felinors as animals (`core-043`'s flavour and `core-062`'s flavour and cast). Re-voice the cards whose voice no longer fits in `apps/web/src/audio/card-audio.json5`. Felinor Fiender's play line must be exactly `More! I need more cats!`. The three generated files are regenerated and committed. No name, tag, rules text, stat, script or `catalog.json` byte changes. The audio for the 15 changed voice keys is owed, and the notes say so.

## Files to touch

| Path | new/change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/cards/card-text.yaml` | change | `flavour` and `voice` lines of `core-007`, `core-032`, `core-043` (flavour only), `core-054`, `core-062`, `core-074`, `core-092`, `core-096`. Nothing else, `zh` untouched |
| `apps/web/src/audio/card-audio.json5` | change | `cards` entries `core-007`, `core-054`, `core-074`, `core-092`, `core-096`: voices (and two effects on Straaza, one on the scarab) |
| `crates/cards/flavour.json` | change (generated) | written by the export test |
| `apps/web/src/audio/voice-text.json` | change (generated) | written by the export test |
| `crates/cards/chinese.json` | generated, expect no diff | the export rewrites it. `zh` is untouched, so it should stay byte-identical. Commit it only if the export changed it |

Do not touch: `crates/cards/catalog.json`, `crates/cards/patches/`, any script under `crates/cards/src/scripts/`, anything in `spec/`, `apps/web/src/audio/cues.test.ts` (its `"Checkmate, puppet."` is the test's own fixture, not shipped data), `docs/polish/2-sound.md` (a historical task table, already out of date), `apps/web/public/audio/voice/` (only the `voice` workflow writes it), `.github/`, `.harness/`, `bot/`.

What governs this: SPEC §10.10 (flavour, R660), §10.11 (voice lines, R655, R1448: a Unit keeps play, attack and death lines, all three in one voice), `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` rows 7–8 and §7. No new ruling: this is presentation only.

## Steps

1. **`crates/cards/card-text.yaml`**: in each entry below, replace only the quoted old text with the new text, keeping the two-space and four-space indentation. Write every new line as a plain YAML scalar with no quotes. None of them starts with a quote, digit or symbol, and none holds `": "` or `" #"`. `core-032`'s flavour is quoted today because of its `": "`. Drop those quotes. I checked every new line with a script: each flavour is at most 120 characters, each voice line is within its word limit (play 8, attack 4, death 6, cast 8) and uses only `[A-Za-z ,.'!?-]`, and no line uses a `BANNED_RULES_WORDS` entry.

   | Entry | Field | Old | New |
   |---|---|---|---|
   | core-007 | flavour | Found in the dairy aisle, guarding a discount nobody asked for. | Just a scarab. It clicks, it chitters, and it rolls whatever it finds into a very neat ball. |
   | core-007 | play | Clean up on aisle you! | Chitter chitter, click! |
   | core-007 | attack | Cleanup time! | Buzz buzz! |
   | core-007 | death | Price check... on death. | Click... click... |
   | core-032 | flavour | "Premium plan. Premium claws. Premium refund policy: none." | Black as midnight, quiet as velvet, and gone before the grass stops moving. |
   | core-032 | play | Premium predator. No ads. | Silent paws. Sharp claws. |
   | core-032 | attack | Premium pounce. | From the shadows! |
   | core-032 | death | Subscription cancelled. | Back to the shadows... |
   | core-043 | flavour | He loves every cat. He has opinions about everything else. | He loves every Felinor. He has opinions about everyone else. |
   | core-054 | flavour | She's been to every shop and haggled with every clerk. | Mother of a hundred hatchlings. She'll lend you two, and burn down anyone who's mean to them. |
   | core-054 | play | Shopping spree! On the house! | Come here, my little ones. |
   | core-054 | attack | Everything must go! | Away from my brood! |
   | core-054 | death | Out of stock. | Look after them for me... |
   | core-062 | flavour | Every cat in the neighbourhood comes when called. They all bring friends. | Throw one party for the Felinors and the whole clan turns up. They all bring friends. |
   | core-062 | cast | Here kitty kitty kitty! | Everyone's invited! Bring your friends! |
   | core-074 | flavour | It resized itself to fit your wallet. | The U stands for Ultimate. The I stands for Infestation. The X stands for however much you've got. |
   | core-074 | cast | Now responsive on all devices! | Unleash the ultimate infestation! |
   | core-092 | flavour | He counts every cat on the field, and then he becomes them. | He knows every Felinor's name, favourite song and which window is theirs. Not one of them told him. |
   | core-092 | play | Cats. I need more cats. | More! I need more cats! |
   | core-092 | attack | Sic 'em, kitties! | For my lovelies! |
   | core-092 | death | Who feeds them now? | They were going to love me... |
   | core-096 | flavour | Not today. Not like this. Maybe never, actually. | He never raised his voice. You made every move yourself, exactly the way he planned it. |
   | core-096 | cast | Checkmate, puppet. | Go on. Play your part. |

   Leave these exactly as they are, because they already fit (record this in the notes): every `core-012` line (meows and pounces are a cat-person's own mannerisms, and the flavour is about triplets, not pets), `core-043`'s three voice lines (a Felinor's own swagger, nobody owning or feeding them), every `core-086` line, and every `core-t-felinor` line. The issue holds up the token's lines as the model for the scarab's noises.

2. **`apps/web/src/audio/card-audio.json5`**, `cards` section: replace these five entries whole with exactly the following. Keep the id, the name comment and the catalog order. Every voice and effect named here is already in the `voices` and `effects` banks, and all of these voices are macOS `say` voices, as every Core card uses:

   ```json5
       "core-007": { // Jewelosco Scarab
         play: { voice: "alien" },
         attack: { voice: "alien", effect: "rattle" },
         death: { voice: "alien" },
       },
   ```
   ```json5
       "core-054": { // Straaza
         play: { voice: "storyteller", effect: "rumble" },
         attack: { voice: "storyteller", effect: "fireWhoosh" },
         death: { voice: "storyteller" },
       },
   ```
   ```json5
       "core-074": { // Adaptive UI
         cast: { voice: "announcer" },
       },
   ```
   ```json5
       "core-092": { // Felinor Fiender
         play: { voice: "whisper" },
         attack: { voice: "whisper" },
         death: { voice: "whisper" },
       },
   ```
   ```json5
       "core-096": { // My Pawn
         cast: { voice: "plain", effect: "gong" },
       },
   ```

   `core-032` (`hero`) and `core-062` (`crone`) keep their entries unchanged.

3. Run `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test export_card_text`. The first run rewrites `crates/cards/flavour.json` and `apps/web/src/audio/voice-text.json` and fails with "…this run rewrote them: commit the result". That failure is expected. Run it a second time: it must pass. Then run `git status --porcelain`. It must list only the four files above (and `crates/cards/chinese.json` only if the export changed it), and never `crates/cards/catalog.json`.

4. Run the tests and checks in **Tests** below and fix anything red. A YAML parse error names the card: check the quoting in step 1.

5. In the delivery notes (which become the PR body), write:
   - the old → new table from step 1 and the voice changes from step 2;
   - this statement: "The audio is owed: 15 voice keys need rendering: `core-007-play`, `core-007-attack`, `core-007-death`, `core-032-play`, `core-032-attack`, `core-032-death`, `core-054-play`, `core-054-attack`, `core-054-death`, `core-062-cast`, `core-074-cast`, `core-092-play`, `core-092-attack`, `core-092-death`, `core-096-cast`. Before merging, a person runs the `voice` workflow on this branch (Actions → voice → Run workflow, or a push whose message holds `[gen:voice]`), then pushes once more so CI runs.";
   - the decisions in **Open questions** 1 and 3.

## Tests

No new test. The existing content tests already hold every new line to its rules, and a test pinning a line's words would only be churn. Run these:

- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test export_card_text`: the sidecars match the YAML, and the entries stay in catalog order with their name comments.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards --test cards r660`: `tests/cross/flavour.rs`, each flavour at most 120 characters, trimmed, on one line.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards`: the whole crate, as the issue asks.
- `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh` once first (the web's test setup loads the WASM module), then `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/audio/voice-lines.test.ts src/audio/voiceData.test.ts src/cards/flavour.test.tsx src/routes/almanac.test.tsx`: B33 (every Unit has play, attack and death lines, and every voice exists), B34 (charset, word limits, the banned-word share), R655 (every effect named is in the bank) and R660 (no flavour line uses a rules word).
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test`: the web's whole unit suite, as the issue asks.
- `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`. The second should report kind App or Internal with no tier and ask for no fragment, because `card-text.yaml` and the sidecars are not card data. If it asks for a fragment, stop and report what it printed. Do not create one.
- Optional, to fill in the notes: `node apps/web/scripts/gen-voice.mjs --check`. It is expected to exit 1, naming exactly the 15 keys in step 5 as stale. Report its output. Do not try to make it pass, and do not run `gen:voice`: Linux has no backend for it.

## Done when

- [ ] Every row of the step 1 table is in `card-text.yaml`, and no other line changed (`git diff crates/cards/card-text.yaml` shows only `flavour:`, `play:`, `attack:`, `death:` and `cast:` lines).
- [ ] `core-092`'s play line is exactly `More! I need more cats!`.
- [ ] The five `card-audio.json5` entries match step 2.
- [ ] `flavour.json` and `voice-text.json` are regenerated, and the second export run passes.
- [ ] `catalog.json`, the scripts, `spec/` and `patches/` are untouched.
- [ ] Every command in **Tests** passes, except `gen-voice --check`, which names only the 15 owed keys.
- [ ] The harness checks pass: rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings, clippy, cargo tests, web tests.
- [ ] The notes hold the old → new list, the owed-audio statement and the decisions.

## Risks

- **YAML quoting.** A line that YAML reads as something other than a string fails the export and names the card. All new lines are plain scalars, so type them exactly as given.
- **Stale audio reaching `main`.** PR CI leaves out `src/audio/**`, so nothing on the PR goes red. But the daily `web (audio, fx, asset and daily tests)` job runs `voice-assets.test.ts` and `gen-voice --check`, and it fails on `main` while the 15 keys are unrendered. The `voice` workflow never runs on `main`, so the render has to happen on the branch before merge. That is why step 5's statement goes in the PR body.
- **Voices chosen without listening.** `alien`, `storyteller`, `announcer`, `whisper` and `plain` were picked by their bank entries (Trinoids' buzz for chitters, Moira for a mother, Superstar's hype for an "ultimate" spell, Whisper for a creepy man, Eddy at `pmod: 0` for a flat calm voice). The owner may re-pick by ear. Only the voice name changes in that case.
- No determinism, replay, hidden-information or engine surface is involved: words and voices are client presentation (CLAUDE.md rule 7, R660, R655).

## Open questions

1. **Fiender's play line.** The issue's table says it "must be exactly 'Cats. I need more cats.'", which is the current line, but **Acceptance** says exactly `More! I need more cats!`. The plan follows Acceptance, so the line changes. If the owner meant the table, set it back to `Cats. I need more cats.`, and `core-092-play` then needs rendering only because of the voice change.
2. **Who renders the audio.** The bot cannot push a `[gen:voice]` commit. A person must run the `voice` workflow on `bot/issue-2653` and push once more before the PR merges. Otherwise the daily audio job goes red on `main` until a follow-up branch renders the keys.
3. **Lines kept by judgment.** `core-012`, `core-043`'s voice lines, `core-086` and `core-t-felinor` stay, because their meows, mrows, pounces and "Big cat" swagger are a cat-person's own mannerisms, not someone treating them as pets. Rejected alternative: rewriting every line that has a meow or says "cat". The owner allows mannerisms, and their own required Fiender line says "cats". Also kept: `core-032`'s `hero` voice (the issue doesn't fault it) and `core-062`'s `crone` (a warm hostess suits a friend). Rejected: `goof` (Boing) for the scarab, whose spring-voice gag reads as a cartoon rather than a bug, and `elder` for Straaza, a grandfather's voice for a mother.
<!-- /jackioh-bot:plan -->
````
